name: Mustek Limited
source: CRON 2026-10-13: FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026) column added from the issuer's results for the year ended 30 June 2026, published 30 September 2026, and the audited annual financial statements approved by the board the same week. Issuer and press printed: revenue R7.26 billion (7,256.05 million), gross profit 924.9 million, operating profit 159.8 million, finance costs 101.8 million, foreign exchange gain 52.6 million, share of associate profit 25.7 million, profit attributable to shareholders 107.6 million and basic earnings per share 198.79 cents (JSE SENS short form announcement of 30 September 2026; TechCentral, Mustek profit soars even as gross margin shrinks). Cost of sales 6,331.15 million and operating expenses 765.13 million derived from the printed revenue, gross profit and operating profit so the column ties. Net finance costs 92.84 million is the printed finance cost of 101.75 million less finance income of 8.91 million. Both printed identities tie on the stored column: revenue 7,256.05 million less cost of sales 6,331.15 million equals gross profit 924.90 million, and profit before tax 142.18 million less income tax 34.57 million equals net profit 107.61 million. Note the gap between operating profit 159.77 and profit before tax 142.18 is the equity-accounted profit, the foreign exchange gain and the loss on disposal of assets, which the panel schema does not carry as separate rows. Ratio rows for FY2026 recomputed from the FY2026 balance figures: net margin 1.48 per cent, gross margin 12.75 per cent and operating margin 2.20 per cent all reproduce the published margin figures. Source pages: https://sharenet.co.za/v3/sens_display.php?scode=&seq=1&tdate=20260930070500 and https://stockanalysis.com/quote/jse/MST/financials/income-statement/ | previous source: Yahoo Finance
